Locks Tier Y30, 1007 bilingual client short vehicle names, and the final user-supplied 17x15 neverSeen triangle SHA 701d74f5...; obsolete inert cnbox_tier_font.py is removed.

Includes complete standalone dependency closure with XVM 13.1.0.0090 and OpenWG.Common 2.8.2.0000; exact Creator R4 owner bytes were confirmed in real game Runtime on 2026-09-23 after Static Diff, two reviews and synthetic install/rollback PASS.

Yellow spotted triangle is replaced by the clearer 17x15 pixel-crisp asset with unchanged geometry. Automatic compatibility preflight, two independent static reviews, synthetic install and exact #03 rollback PASS. Runtime was explicitly not required for this low-risk delta; targeted Runtime is reserved for an observed in-game issue.

aslainFingerprints.notes: Locked user preset exact-build discriminator from official Aslain #03 full-preset CLI reproduction. Uses non-CNBOX files; CNBOX never modifies them.

languagePacks.notes: Reusable dynamic translation donor base. Origin: ASIA/CN WoT 2.4.0.1. Manager v1.2.0 uses the CURRENT NA .mo set as the skeleton, writes the merged language layer only under versioned res_mods, preserves the NA loc_version version/revision while localized mode uses language=zh_sg, invalidates data.wgpdc so WoT rebuilds VehicleItem/VehicleType localization caches, supports direct Chinese-vehicle-name <-> English-vehicle-name switching without an intermediate restore, and displays the confirmed current localization mode in the Manager UI. Unmatched current-NA text remains English.
